aligned_bytes_semantics: sum of tensor payloads rounded independently to the explicit transfer-descriptor alignment; allocator reservation excluded
content_identity_note: checkpoint revision, tensor name, shard, dtype, shape and known bytes; no full checkpoint hash rescan
immutable_weight_eviction_semantics: release/discard device allocation and reload from immutable checkpoint-backed host source; no D2H writeback
packed_bytes_semantics: uncompressed safetensors tensor payload; container header and inter-tensor padding excluded
